rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Guardian Engine verifies AI-generated recipes against curated master recipes for 20 dishes across 12 cuisines. It catches hallucinated temperatures, missing techniques, wrong ingredients, and impossible cooking steps before they reach production. The hosted MCP endpoint requires no authentication during early access and supports both verification and dish catalog browsing.
